_comment: SLICE 9 MOVE (2026-07-09, #410) — workflow-trigger.md RETIRED from the pickup doc-open floor, capture-gated. Driver = census INLINE: the trigger-first gist is inlined in SKILL.md (step 2 authoritative-trigger rule, step 5 keep-the-trigger-explicit, session-open guardrail) and the live trigger TEXT lives in the artifact's `## Workflow Trigger` section, which the planner forces as the FIRST required read — the reference re-read was a redundant doc-open proxy. plan_handoff_run.py no longer forces references/workflow-trigger.md for the pickup intent (it STAYS forced for judge_from_user_request, a different load-bearing purpose). The prior deferral ('a faithful pickup hands off to the invoked workflow, so its closeout RSF token is fragile') is resolved by NOT using an RSF: the replacement floor is the sibling outcome-assertions.json SUBSTANCE judge (pickup-starts-named-workflow et al.), which grades the handoff-owned behavior from the transcript regardless of which workflow owns the final message. RCF=[] + RSF=[] is valid per claim_fidelity_lib substance-floor-only support (325909f7). classTag INLINE is safe once off the RCF. Floor verified by a fresh ask-before-run capture (see the Slice-9 bundle under charness-artifacts/cautilus/) — token/behavior OBSERVED, not assumed. --- PRIOR: SLICE 4 RESOLUTION (2026-07-02) — #412 PLANNER CONDITIONALIZED (commit c1a66f4d). plan_handoff_run.py now emits continuation-sequence.md for pickup ONLY when the pickup is ambiguous, so this CLEAR-pickup floor drops it: RCF=[workflow-trigger.md] (mirrors the planner). The existing Slice-7 pickup capture (opened workflow-trigger.md, skipped continuation-sequence.md) re-grades PASS under this floor. continuation-sequence.md is reclassified on-demand DEPTH (not the census INLINE — the planner change reveals it IS load-bearing under the ambiguous condition), and its ambiguous arm is proven falsifiably by the sibling pickup-ambiguous.spec.json + a fresh ask-before-run capture. --- PRIOR CONTEXT: SLICE-7 CENSUS RECONCILIATION (2026-07-01) — SUPERSEDES THE CAPTURE-ONLY FRAMING BELOW WHERE IT CONTRADICTS census.json. Reconciled verdicts: workflow-trigger.md=MOVE (census INLINE; trigger-first gist inlined in SKILL.md step 5 — the open was redundant, 'PROVEN' below is the method error). continuation-sequence.md=MOVE (census INLINE; the pickup run correctly SKIPPED it — this is also #412, the planner over-requiring it unconditionally). Both floors are census INLINE redundant doc-opens; replacement is an emitted-token RSF proven by a fresh capture (FORM-floor over-relaxation risk noted — no substance judge). Full adversarial (analyze→verify) resolution + capture-gated queue: charness-artifacts/reference-compaction/slice7-census-reconciliation.md. classTag/RCF are intentionally NOT flipped here: claim_fidelity_lib forbids DUP/INLINE-tagging a live RCF floor, so the tag/RCF flip rides with the capture-gated MOVE (no substance judge + no retained stream ⇒ each MOVE needs a fresh ask-before-run capture). --- ORIGINAL SPEC COMMENT: Claim-fidelity spec for the handoff skill, PICKUP scenario. See spec.json for the planner/lens-4 split rationale. The prompt carries a list-verb task directive (`start the named workflow`) that bypasses the chunker plus pickup wording (`resume`), so `plan_handoff_run.py` deterministically resolves intent=pickup, whose planner _required_reads are workflow-trigger.md + continuation-sequence.md (the RCF). Every other reference is on-demand here (read under a different intent or condition). declaredReferences is the full set (coverage). referenceEngagement uses the engage-always/on-demand/gate-sufficient axis from the methodology contract (charness-artifacts/spec/2026-06-23-skill-claim-fidelity-doc-philosophy.md). thresholds omitted until a baseline capture sets a budget. SLICE 7 (2026-07-01) CAPTURE — workflow-trigger.md PROVEN load-bearing (opened), so #410's 'drop workflow-trigger.md -> RSF' is REFUTED. But continuation-sequence.md was NOT opened: the pickup was unambiguous (one clear pinned task), and continuation-sequence.md is for 'when several plausible pickups exist' (SKILL.md). plan_handoff_run.py UNCONDITIONALLY emits continuation-sequence.md for the pickup intent, so this RCF mirrors the planner and the eval correctly FLAGS the gap — a PLANNER over-requirement finding (filed follow-up), NOT a spec softening. RCF is KEPT planner-faithful (this scenario's floor legitimately fails until the planner conditionalizes continuation-sequence.md). document-seams.md removed + deleted (DUP). --- ROUTING SOURCE CHANGED (slice 1 of 2026-08-09-make-proof-surfaces-report-what-they-observed): the regex classifier `should_fire_chunker` is DELETED, so nothing here is decided by matching the invocation text any more. The agent declares the route with `plan_handoff_run.py --intent <...>` (or `--invoked-directly` for a bare launch), and a settled pickup names its task with `--pickup-target`, which is what now skips continuation-sequence.md. CORRECTION to the first draft of this note, which claimed the arm was unchanged in substance: the ROUTE is unchanged, the DISCRIMINATION is not. This was the CLEAR arm because the planner read 'the pinned task' out of the invocation text; nothing reads that now, and the planner runs at bootstrap BEFORE the artifact is read, so the agent cannot yet supply `--pickup-target`. Against a handoff with >=2 `## Next Session` entries this arm and `pickup-ambiguous` now produce the SAME planner output, and neither hard-fails (this RCF is empty; the sibling's read is still forced), so the collapse is silent. The clear/ambiguous discrimination MOVED to tests/test_handoff_plan.py (`test_handoff_plan_pickup_skips_continuation_when_target_declared` and its whitespace sibling). Re-scoping this scenario pair is deferred work, not a claim that it still discriminates. Any sentence above describing a chunker bypass by verb or token is HISTORY, not current mechanism.
prompt: /charness:handoff resume the pinned task from the current state and start the named workflow before doing anything else

adapter-contract.md.rationale: The planner reads this only when the adapter is missing, warned, or invalid; a healthy repo resolves the artifact location from the resolved adapter without opening the explainer doc.
adapter-contract.md.trigger: adapter is missing, warned, or invalid (planner _required_reads condition)

chunked-routing.md.rationale: A chunked_routing-intent planner read; not opened on a pickup run that carries a task directive.
chunked-routing.md.trigger: bare/namespaced invocation with no task directive — route the backlog before pickup

continuation-sequence.md.rationale: A pickup-intent CONDITIONAL planner required read: plan_handoff_run.py emits it only when the pickup is AMBIGUOUS (no clearly-pinned task AND >=2 plausible pickups). This clear-pickup scenario pins one task, so the planner does not force it. It is load-bearing under the ambiguous condition — see the pickup-ambiguous scenario. STALE as of the declared-routing change: 'pins one task' is no longer something the planner can observe -- it is the caller's `--pickup-target` declaration, which this scenario cannot supply at bootstrap. Treat this rationale as history; the live discrimination is the unit test.
continuation-sequence.md.trigger: ambiguous pickup — several plausible pickups exist (no clearly-pinned next task)

spill-targets.md.rationale: A refresh-intent planner read; not opened on a pickup run.
spill-targets.md.trigger: refresh intent — spilling durable detail to its owning artifact instead of growing a diary

state-selection.md.rationale: A refresh/judge-intent planner read; not opened on a pickup run.
state-selection.md.trigger: refresh intent — keeping only state that changes the next action

workflow-trigger.md.rationale: Census INLINE (#410 Slice 9): the trigger-first gist is inlined in SKILL.md (step 2, step 5, session-open guardrail) and the live trigger text is in the artifact's `## Workflow Trigger`, already the planner's first forced read. The reference stays as WHY-prose for trigger AUTHORING; a pickup run needs the artifact, not this doc. Pickup fidelity is floored by the sibling outcome-assertions.json substance judge instead of this doc-open.
workflow-trigger.md.trigger: authoring or repairing a trigger line — consulting the naming rule's WHY-prose
